name: novaku-ui-system
purpose: Agent-operable UI design system entrypoint for the Novaku/Postervia Expo app.
principle: Correct UI should be the easiest path: use blessed interfaces, recipes, dev gallery states, and verification commands before writing custom layout.
required_before_any_ui_change: Use components/Screen.tsx for screen composition unless the file is a tiny framed sub-surface inside another Screen
Add or update a dev gallery state when the UI introduces a new reusable primitive, recipe, or risky state

screen.rule: Route screens compose with Screen instead of re-deriving SafeArea, AppBackground, keyboard, or tab bar padding.

layout.rule: Never copy tab bar geometry into route files. Use getTabBarHeight(bottomInset).

tokens.rule: Prefer semantic tokens and blessed primitives over local hex/radius/shadow definitions.

i18n.rule: Any user-visible copy must enter the language system. Dev gallery copy is the exception and stays English-only.

blessed_primitives.name: Screen
blessed_primitives.use_when: Any route-level screen, full-screen modal body, or tab screen.

blessed_primitives.name: PageHeader
blessed_primitives.use_when: Standard top page title, subtitle, and language/header actions.

blessed_primitives.name: GlassCard
blessed_primitives.use_when: Warm rounded card surface that should match the app visual language.

blessed_primitives.name: SurfaceCard
blessed_primitives.use_when: Static card or panel shell where layout must not depend on Pressable callback styles.

blessed_primitives.name: FeedbackPressable
blessed_primitives.use_when: Any pressable needing press feedback: static `style` + `pressedStyle` props. Never use style={({ pressed }) => ...} — nativewind css-interop drops callback-style output on native (GOTCHAS 坑 #7); usePressedFeedback (hooks/usePressedFeedback.ts) is the hook form for custom components.

blessed_primitives.name: ListRow
blessed_primitives.use_when: Reusable one-row item with leading icon, copy, optional meta, and optional chevron.

blessed_primitives.name: StateBlock
blessed_primitives.use_when: Empty, loading, error, success, and quiet status states with consistent icon and action layout.

blessed_primitives.name: IconCircleButton
blessed_primitives.use_when: Compact icon-only actions with consistent hit area and visual style.

blessed_primitives.name: SectionLabel
blessed_primitives.use_when: Section dividers and uppercase section labels.

blessed_primitives.name: StackedButton
blessed_primitives.use_when: Large stacked CTA surfaces in modals and focused flows.

current_recipes.name: OAuth registration confirmation
current_recipes.status: shared Google/Apple legal-confirmation recipe, rendered by /dev/auth-oauth
current_recipes.invariant: Provider profile data stays read-only; a shared platform range with lower bound 16+ auto-completes registration after the disclosed provider action, while missing, declined, ambiguous, or unsupported signals fall back to exact birth date and explicit legal consent.

current_recipes.name: Buddy wish creation
current_recipes.status: expandable entry plus image-first wish recipe, rendered by /dev/buddy-wish
current_recipes.invariant: The primary plus expands upward into explicit companion and wish actions; wish photos remain optional and user-controlled.

current_recipes.name: Buddy wish photo picker
current_recipes.status: shared wish media recipe, rendered by /dev/buddy-wish
current_recipes.invariant: Up to five images, first image is the cover, and upload failures keep existing form state.

current_recipes.name: OdysseyTaskLineCard
current_recipes.invariant: Static visual shell must not depend on Pressable pressed-state callback styles.

current_recipes.name: Plaza post card
current_recipes.status: extracted feature recipe, consumed by app/(tabs)/plaza.tsx

current_recipes.name: Community post image viewer
current_recipes.status: extracted feature recipe, consumed by CommunityPostDetailModal and rendered by /dev/ui-system
current_recipes.invariant: Multi-image posts expose high-contrast previous/next controls and a counter; single-image posts hide pager controls.

current_recipes.name: Chat message bubble
current_recipes.status: named export MessageBubble, rendered by /dev/network-resilience; extraction deferred until SOCIAL-UI-002 (codex) lands

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Route screen manually composes AppBackground + SafeArea + ScrollView padding
Hard-coded tab bar bottom padding or copied 64 + inset formulas
forbidden_patterns.enforced_by: npm run verify:ui (literal 3-digit paddingBottom in app/(tabs)/*.tsx fails; social.tsx allowlisted until SOCIAL-UI-002 lands)

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Essential layout/shell styles placed only in Pressable callback style
forbidden_patterns.use_instead: FeedbackPressable (or usePressedFeedback) with static style + pressedStyle
forbidden_patterns.enforced_by: npm run verify:ui (any resting styles inside style={({ pressed }) => ...} fail; app/dev/pressable-probe.tsx allowlisted as the intentional broken specimen)

forbidden_patterns.pattern: New user-visible copy written directly in a component
Reusable UI pattern implemented only inside a route after it appears twice
forbidden_patterns.use_instead: Extract to components/ or features/<area>/ with dev gallery coverage

forbidden_patterns.pattern: UI declared done without rendering long German, empty, loading, own, and other states
forbidden_patterns.use_instead: app/dev gallery route plus Expo Web render check

verification_surfaces.native_follow_up: Expo Web catches layout drift; native-only surfaces still need real device or Maestro verification.

new_ui_workflow: Identify whether the work is foundation, primitive, recipe, or screen.
Prefer an existing blessed primitive or recipe before writing local layout.
If a local pattern appears twice or owns a risky invariant, extract it into a primitive or recipe.
Add dev gallery states for any new primitive or recipe.
Run the verification commands and report what could not be visually verified.
